turns.replyText:
To get the best result from your Rug & Pad Set:

Place it on a flat, hard floor and clear the area first. Tumble rugs may work on a low-pile, firm carpet, but they’re generally best on hard surfaces.
Lay out the numbered Cushioned Rug Pad pieces and connect the interlocking edges until they lie flat.
Place the rug cover over the pad and tuck each pad corner into the matching patented corner pocket underneath the cover.
Center the cover, smooth it from the middle outward, gently pull it taut, and apply the included corner grippers before placing furniture on it.
Use the complete Rug & Pad Set together. Don’t add another pad or use a third-party pad, as that can affect stability and performance.

For care, remove the cover before machine washing it. Keep the pad out of the washing machine. Vacuum it or gently wipe it with soap and water, and let it dry completely before putting the cover back on. After a spill, lift the set and make sure both the rug and floor are fully dry.

The visual setup guide is here: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/assembly
